positioning.summary: Product leader connecting agent capabilities, APIs, data, governance, vendor integrations, and operational workflows. Production background includes Amazon, BECU, startups, commerce, digital banking, Open Banking, supply chain, and consumer experiences. Recent Hapa work explores reusable human-agent memory, context, modular capability, observability, evaluation, provenance, and approval patterns.
